title: 10 Old Habits Waiting for a Godly Man Over Christmas Break
caption:
You go home for break and the old version of you is waiting in your childhood bedroom like he never left.

Same bed. Same friends. Same door that locks. No schedule, nobody checking, three weeks of empty days.

This is where a lot of men lose the whole semester's ground. Not because they planned to. Because they didn't plan at all.

Pick the two on this list that have your name on them and decide now, before you're home.

Save this for the drive. Send it to the brother heading home with you.
